missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Полковник' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'вошёл'. 'В кабинет' shows the accusative destination of motion into a place. A clean introduction.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative equals genitive. 'Полковника' takes the -а ending because the noun is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'На улице' adds the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Полковника' is the genitive showing whose order it is. 'Нашего' is the agreeing masculine genitive. A core attribution pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative indirect object. 'Полковнику' is the dative recipient of the report. The verb 'доложил' takes a dative person, and 'о результатах' adds the prepositional-plural topic.

missions.phrase: Я служил под началом с полковником.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Полковником' is the instrumental after the preposition 'с', meaning together with. The phrase 'под началом' frames the service relationship.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Полковнике' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.

Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Полковника' follows 'у' in the genitive to express possession. 'Важное задание' is the nominative thing possessed, with 'было' agreeing in the neuter.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Полковника' follows 'два' and takes the genitive singular required after two, three, and four. 'На параде' sets the prepositional location.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural equals genitive. 'Полковников' takes the genitive-plural -ов ending, which serves as the accusative because the noun is animate. 'Всех этих' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun. 'Полковник' is nominative as the predicate. 'Строгий' and 'опытный' are agreeing masculine adjectives describing his character, joined by 'и'.
